home.titleLead: The platform to run your firm’s appraisals,

home.subtitle: Orders, inspections, the AIC0124 report, signing and billing in one place. For firm owners, managers and the appraisers who work with them.
home.valuesTitle: Made for the work between the order and the invoice

values.title: Less time writing the report
values.body: The AIC0124 is filled in from the documents already in the file. You start from a draft instead of a blank form, and spend your time on the opinion.

values.title: The whole file in one place
values.body: Order, client, appointment, inspection notes, photos, report and invoice stay together. Nobody digs through email for the latest version.

values.title: Get paid sooner
values.body: Invoices go out with the right provincial tax, clients pay by card and reminders follow up for you. You can hold the report until it is paid.

values.title: Work from your phone at the inspection
values.body: The inspection form runs on the phone and keeps working without signal. It syncs once you are back in coverage.

home.howLead: Every appraisal follows the same path, and everything stays in the file.

steps.title: Receive the order
steps.body: An order comes in from a client or from your website, and opens a file.

steps.title: Schedule and inspect
steps.body: Book the appointment, see it on the map and in Google Calendar. Inspect on the phone, with or without signal.

steps.title: The report is filled in from your documents
steps.body: The AIC0124 is prepared from the file’s documents. The appraiser reviews it and writes the opinion.

steps.title: Review, sign, deliver and get paid
steps.body: Quality review, signing with a verification certificate, then the invoice with the right tax and card payment.

home.ctaBody: Send a request and we will contact you within 1 to 5 business days.

features.title: What QuickAppraiser does
features.lead: Grouped the way work moves through your firm, from the order to the payment.

groups.title: Orders and clients
groups.intro: Every appraisal starts as a file, and the file keeps everything.

items.title: Appraisal files
items.body: Each order opens a file that holds the property, the client, the documents, the inspection, the report and the invoice.

items.title: Clients
items.body: Your clients and their contacts, linked to the files you do for them.

items.title: Leads from your website
items.body: Requests sent from your firm’s own website arrive as leads, ready to become files.

items.title: Recycle bin
items.body: A file deleted by mistake goes to the recycle bin first, and you can recover it from there.

groups.title: Scheduling and inspection
groups.intro: Plan the day and inspect on site, signal or not.

items.title: Appointment map
items.body: See your inspectors’ appointments on a map and plan the day around the driving.

items.title: Google Calendar
items.body: Appointments are pushed to Google Calendar, where your team already looks.

items.title: Inspection on the phone
items.body: Inspectors fill in the inspection on their phone. It works without signal and syncs when coverage returns.

items.title: Photos
items.body: Photos taken during the inspection are attached to the file.

groups.title: The report
groups.intro: The form is prepared from your documents. The opinion stays the appraiser’s.

items.title: The AIC0124 form
items.body: The official AIC0124 form is filled in from the documents in the file.

items.title: The appraiser’s opinion
items.body: The appraiser reviews it and writes their opinion. Adjustments, valuation and narrative remain the appraiser’s own work, and the appraiser signs it.

items.title: English and French
items.body: Produce reports in English or in French.

items.title: Your cover letter
items.body: Each firm uses its own cover letter.

groups.title: Quality and signing
groups.intro: Catch what is missing before anything is signed.

items.title: Quality review
items.body: Reports go through a quality review before they are signed.

items.title: Rules that flag gaps
items.body: Rules point out what is missing before the report goes out.

items.title: Independence declaration
items.body: The appraiser completes an independence declaration before signing.

items.title: Signing with a certificate
items.body: Reports are signed with a verification certificate.

groups.title: Billing
groups.intro: Invoice correctly and get paid without chasing.

items.title: Provincial tax
items.body: Invoices carry the tax of the property’s province (HST, GST or QST).

items.title: Card payments
items.body: Clients pay by card through Stripe.

items.title: Automatic reminders
items.body: Reminders follow up on unpaid invoices for you.

items.title: Refunds
items.body: Issue a refund when one is needed.

items.title: Appraiser commissions
items.body: Keep track of your appraisers’ commissions.

items.title: Release on payment
items.body: If you choose, the report is released only once it is paid.

groups.title: Team and security
groups.intro: The right access for each person, and only your firm’s data.

items.title: Roles
items.body: Admin, appraiser and inspector roles decide who can do what.

items.title: Two-factor authentication
items.body: Protect sign-in with a second factor.

items.title: Single sign-on (SSO)
items.body: Your team signs in with your company directory.

items.title: Separate firm data
items.body: Each firm sees only its own data.

items.title: Audit trail
items.body: An audit trail records who did what, and when.

groups.title: For lenders
groups.intro: A direct way for lenders to look up their appraisals.

items.title: Lender API
items.body: A lender can look up its appraisals through an API.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.lead: Short answers to the questions firms ask first.

items.a: QuickAppraiser is made for residential appraisal firms across Canada, in every province and territory. Invoices carry the tax of the property’s province or territory, and reports can be written in English or French.
The AIC0124, the official form. It is filled in from the documents in the file. The appraiser then reviews it, writes the opinion and signs it.

items.q: Does it work on a phone and without signal?
items.a: Yes. The inspection form works on the phone. Without signal, it keeps what you enter and syncs when coverage returns. Photos are attached to the file.

items.q: Can I bring my files from another platform?
items.a: Yes, there is an import for files from another platform. Mention the platform you use today in your request.

Each firm sees only its own data. Inside the firm, roles (Admin, appraiser, inspector) set what each person can do, sign-in can be protected with two-factor authentication, and an audit trail records who did what.
It depends on the size of your team and on whether you are bringing files from another platform. Once you send a request, we contact you within 1 to 5 business days to plan it with you.
